answered.sql: SELECT Movie.title, Studio.name AS studio_name, Producer.full_name AS producer_name FROM Movie JOIN Studio ON Movie.studio_id = Studio.id JOIN Producer ON Movie.producer_id = Producer.id

candidates.meaning: Who made each production? Split by movie
candidates.sql: SELECT Movie.title AS movie, Producer.full_name AS producer FROM Movie JOIN Producer ON Movie.producer_id = Producer.id

candidates.meaning: Identify the producer for each movie and list them separately.
candidates.sql: SELECT Movie.title, Producer.full_name AS made_each_production FROM Movie JOIN Producer ON Movie.producer_id = Producer.id

candidates.meaning: List the actor who played the main character in each movie and the producer of the movie.
candidates.sql: SELECT Movie.title, Producer.full_name AS made_each_production, Character.character_name AS main_character, Actor.first_name || ' ' || Actor.last_name AS actor_name FROM Movie JOIN Producer ON Movie.producer_id = Producer.id JOIN Character ON Movie.id = Character.movie_id JOIN Actor ON Character.actor_id = Actor.id WHERE Character.character_name = 'Cobb' OR Character.character_name = 'Arthur'

candidates.meaning: List the studio that produced each movie and the producer of the movie.
candidates.sql: SELECT Movie.title, Producer.full_name AS made_each_production, Studio.name AS studio_name FROM Movie JOIN Producer ON Movie.producer_id = Producer.id JOIN Studio ON Movie.studio_id = Studio.id
